text: This is at the very top of the mountain. These are my Cambodians guys. they were getting ready to eat it and I wanted some and i got some. It was good. When you are eating sea rations, anything is good.
researchNotes: "sea rations" is his son's spelling of the sound as he typed, not a spelling Larry chose (his son, 2026-09-13). It almost certainly means C-rations, the individual canned meals; that is a reading, not his word. Rations on the mountain: data/recollections/2026-09-13-son-mountain-rations.json.
